## RSEng Lab Module

*Applied Research Software Engineering in scientific institutions*

This lab module provides students with a hands-on opportunity to apply research software engineering principles to real-world scientific problems from the MINT disciplines (Mathematics, Informatics, Natural Sciences, and Technology). Students work in teams on projects originating from active research contexts — such as simulations in physics, data analysis in chemistry, modeling in biology, or ...
